name: Publish this workspace as a pack
description: Turn this workspace's Pack Mode draft (.t3pack/draft.pack.json) into a real, signed pack with real knowledge entries, instead of a plain markdown writeup
phrasings: turn this chat into a pack
package this workspace into a pack
make a pack from what we just did
turn our conversation into a pack
build a pack from this session
create a pack from this workspace
turn this into a reusable pack
make this into a pack other people can use

params.name: name
params.desc: the pack's name, if the person already has one in mind

prompt: Publish or update a pack from this workspace's Pack Mode draft using the publish-workspace-pack pack. First check .t3pack/draft.pack.json exists — if it doesn't, tell the person Pack Mode needs to be enabled and at least one turn run before there's anything to publish. Then follow that pack's integration prompt exactly.
